alex.recruiter: Hey people-ops — candidate offer for IC3/SW Eng (EMEA->US) needs an exception. Relocation + sign-on total is $14,500, base would land at band M2 (180k) but hiring mgr requested M3 peg for promo runway. Start date conflict: candidate can start remote 2024-04-25 but can't be on payroll until 2024-05-15 due to visa. Can we frontload sign-on or pay partial upfront?
priya.peopleops: Thanks Alex. Need clarification: is the request to bump base band (permanent comp) to M3 or just a one-time relocation/sign-on uplift? That changes routing.
sam.hiringmgr: It's just a temporary uplift — base stays M2. We want M3 salary reflected in offer for first 6mo to help retention, then revert. Candidate is critical.
noah.finance: Heads up — any band uplift that affects permanent base requires total comp sign-off from finance + VP. One-time sign-ons > $10k need CFO approval per policy. If it's time-limited sign-on/relocation we can route to the comp committee and Finance.
alex.recruiter: OK making it explicit: request = one-time relocation $7,500 + sign-on $8,000 (total $15,500). Base remains M2 180k. Candidate requests earlier remote start 2024-04-25 for project ramp. Payroll start 2024-05-15. How do we reflect early start in offer and benefits eligibility?
priya.peopleops: Two things: 1) Benefits eligibility follows payroll start date (05-15), so benefits and 401k start will be 05-15 unless we front-date via HR ops (rare). 2) For tax/payroll: we can do a "preboarding stipend" to cover early engagement (contractor-like) but needs legal sign-off. Alternatively, pay sign-on on payroll after 05-15.
sam.hiringmgr: Preboarding stipend would be acceptable to candidate — can ops/finance confirm feasibility? We need to close by EOD Wednesday.
noah.finance: We can approve one-time sign-on payment on payroll after 05-15. For preboarding stipend before payroll, Finance + Legal need to confirm classification. I'll ping Legal. Also will need CFO sign-off because > $10k.
priya.peopleops: Routing plan: I'll open a comp-exception request in the committee queue with these fields: candidate name (redacted), role, base M2 180k, one-time payments: relocate $7,500 + sign-on $8,000, early remote start request 04-25 with payroll 05-15. I'll tag Hiring Manager Sam and Finance Noah. If Committee approves, People Ops will attach approval note to offer and instruct Payroll for payment timing.
offer-bot: Offer created (ID: OFR-2024-0887). Draft sent to candidate with conditional language: "remote start permitted; compensation and benefits effective upon payroll onboarding 2024-05-15; sign-on payment subject to approval."
alex.recruiter: Thanks — please also include fallback language re: relocation reimbursement cap and repayment if candidate leaves within 12 months.
priya.peopleops: Good call. Adding repayment clause and escalation: if committee denies preboarding stipend, we default to payroll payment on 05-15. I'll circulate the comp-exception form now :email:.
noah.finance: I'll fast-track CFO approval request once Priya files the comp-exception ticket. Marking as urgent. :eyes:
sam.hiringmgr: Appreciate it. Candidate is in final interview loop today; need offer signed by Friday.
priya.peopleops: Understood. Filing now. Will update thread with ticket link and committee ETA. Thanks everyone.
